_comment_paths: Absolute paths and connection strings are host-specific. POSIX: vault_path '/home/<user>/Documents/TheBrainOfChris', database_url 'postgresql:///engram?host=/var/run/postgresql' (Unix socket, peer auth, no password). Windows: vault_path 'C:\Users\<user>\Documents\TheBrainOfChris', database_url 'postgresql://<user>:<password>@127.0.0.1:5432/engram' — Windows Postgres has no Unix socket, so TCP with a real password is required.
auth_token: <random secret — 32 random bytes as hex; see README section 2 for the generator>
